verdict.rationale: An authentication product could plausibly expose versioned APIs with a deprecation policy, so this axis applies. The evidence pack documents only end-user app features and contains no versioned API or deprecation policy. Probes for an OpenAPI spec all returned 404, and the community report about the autofill feature being discontinued is a feature retirement, not an API deprecation policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
